# Atai

> Atai.ink is an AI business-building platform. Founders turn an idea, a website, a URL, or a GitHub project into a real digital business — plan, build, launch, manage, and grow in one place.

Atai (Advanced Technologies and AI Enterprises) is not a generic website cloner. It is an AI co-founder for non-technical founders and operators: collaborative planning, application generation, hosting, and day-to-day business operations.

The Atai SDK and a single Atai API key are supporting infrastructure inside that product. Generated apps and developers can call AI, payments, maps, messaging, auth, search, data, and related services without stitching many vendors. That key is one capability of the platform, not the product itself.

## What founders do here

- Describe a business idea or start from a site / GitHub repo
- Collaborate on a plain-language plan before any build spend
- Generate and deploy a working application
- Operate customers, billing, and growth from the workspace

## Developers (optional)

Same infrastructure the builder uses, via `@atai-group/sdk` and an Atai API key (`atai_proj_...`). See /developers and /sdk. Start at the homepage if you are launching a business, not an integration.
